title: Thinkers50 Names Incorruptible One of the Best New Management Books of 2026
summary: The premier global ranking of management thinkers names Incorruptible to its annual list of best new management books, alongside titles from Linda Hill, Ranjay Gulati, Joe Pine, and others.
blockquote: 'Incorruptible' by Eric Ries on scaling without losing integrity or purpose through creative and strategic change
attribution_title: Premier global ranking of management thinkers; founded by Des Dearlove and Stuart Crainer
